text:
ashley: quick follow-up re: policy invalidation risk. caches can keep pointing at drained regions. need plan.

samir: yep. two options: shorten TTL on policy change, or targeted invalidation.

jun: sidecar makes targeted invalidation easy (fanout + ack). lib-inproc is messier.

margo: propose compiler emits compact fingerprint blobs at compile-time. control-plane POSTs invalidate with blob URL + version. sidecars fetch and evict or mark-stale. always keep a safety TTL.

ashley: when to evict immediately vs mark-stale?

samir: if route QPS > HOT_QPS -> mark-stale + probe; else assign short TTL.

jun: sidecar API sketch: POST /policy/v1/invalidate {policy_id, version, blob_url} -> {accepted, queued}. idempotent via version. rate-limit processing.

margo: telemetry: emit invalidation.event (policy_id, version, est_routes, acks, nacks, p95_eviction_ms). alert if nacks>0.5% or p95_eviction>30s.

sre-bot: note: add runbook entry for detecting stuck invalidations and rollback steps.

ashley: rollout: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> global. abort if 99p latency > baseline+50ms or invalidation NACK rate >0.5%.

samir: i'll wire sim (replay hot-skewed traffic + region failure). jun owns sidecar changes. margo owns dashboard. i'll attach sim job id.

ashley: i'll write RFC appendix and rollout checklist. thanks! :thumbsup:
